import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { country } from "../../../backend/schema/country";

export const countryCms = customizeTable<typeof country>("country", {
    display: {
        title: "country"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    fields: {
        country: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["countryId", "lastUpdate", "country"]
});
